primary_title: HTLV-1 activates YAP via NF-kB/p65 to promote oncogenesis
decision_basis: Primary co-immunoprecipitation, domain mapping and nuclear colocalization support YAP1-RELA/p65 complex formation with bounded Hippo-NFkB crosstalk.
limitations_preserved: Preserve HTLV-1/ATL, expression-perturbation and nuclear-complex context; RELA is not a new terminal-TF inference; no SCI transfer.

primary_title: YAP Controls Endothelial Activation and Vascular Inflammation Through TRAF6
decision_basis: Primary endothelial co-immunoprecipitation, ubiquitination and genetic rescue support direct YAP1-TRAF6 inhibitory crosstalk.
limitations_preserved: Preserve endothelial, LPS/CLP and K48-versus-K63 ubiquitination context; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Reciprocal inhibition of YAP/TAZ and NF-kB regulates osteoarthritic cartilage degradation
decision_basis: Primary co-immunoprecipitation, in-vitro kinase and TAK1/YAP perturbation support YAP1-TAK1 association and restricted IKK/NF-kB signaling.
limitations_preserved: Preserve TNF-alpha/IL-1beta, chondrocyte/osteoarthritis and TAK1-mediated YAP degradation context; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Hippo signalling governs cytosolic nucleic acid sensing through YAP/TAZ-mediated TBK1 blockade
decision_basis: Primary depletion/reconstitution and ubiquitination/activation assays support direct YAP1-TBK1 association and antiviral signaling blockade.
limitations_preserved: Preserve cytosolic nucleic-acid and antiviral context; no universal IRF3, SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Hippo signalling governs cytosolic nucleic acid sensing through YAP/TAZ-mediated TBK1 blockade

primary_title: Targeting IRF3 as a YAP agonist therapy against gastric cancer
decision_basis: Primary co-immunoprecipitation, purified-protein pull-down and domain mapping support activated-IRF3/YAP1 nuclear complex formation with bounded gastric-cancer function.
limitations_preserved: Preserve activated-IRF3, gastric-cancer and YAP-TEAD4 co-occupancy context; IRF3 is not a new terminal-TF inference; no SCI transfer.
